core_genre_rule: Exactly one scoring core genre; up to two optional auxiliary genres/tags; no averaging different genre weights
lyrics_expression_rule: The FIRST dimension slot is shared. Meaningful language -> Lyrics; nonsemantic/wordless -> Expression; mixed -> manual album-level first-slot verdict after duration-weighted advisory
voice_rule: The presence of a human voice alone does not imply Lyrics; unknown-language semantic content is not wordless
mixed_album_rule: Duration-weighted first-slot rating is advisory only; midpoint at adjacent half-star midpoint plus/minus 0.05 star requires manual review; do not average the other five dimensions by track
electronic_performance_rule: Performance evaluates evidence-supported temporal realization; programming/composition or sound design by itself must not double-count as performance; lack of traditional instrumentalists is not a score penalty
n_a_policy: New six-dimensional reviews require all six dimensions. Legacy N/A remains archived, never auto-mapped to Expression or zero and never silently redistributed
publish_guard: All genre weights are research candidates, no pre-approved profiles. Explicit editor approval with audit identity/date and record/listening evidence needed before public publication
naming_rule: Canonical zh label is 国风 with stable ID genre:chinese-style-pop; en is Guofeng; 古风 remains separate; legacy display aliases are archival only
legacy_data_policy: Never mutate historical reviews, weights, totals, or computed displays without an explicit versioned re-evaluation action and independent snapshot
disallowed: auto-score from popularity; auto-approve all 522 weights; language/region auto-bonuses; arbitrary source/culture adjustments; five-dimensional runtime redistribution; final score derived from track-level star average; treating 0.01 differences as incontrovertible qualitative ranking
evidence_status: no complete multi-album blind listening or independent inter-rater validation documented for V0.34
